description: Header file defining interface functions for vehicle speed sensor management, including getting speed, initialization, mock setting, and sensor status checks.

methods.name: getVehicleSpeed
methods.description: Returns the current vehicle speed in kilometers per hour.

methods.name: initVehicleSpeed
methods.description: Initializes the vehicle speed sensor subsystem, takes a logger object.

methods.name: setMockVehicleSpeed
methods.description: Sets a mock vehicle speed value, mostly for testing purposes.

methods.name: hasVehicleSpeedSensor
methods.description: Checks if the vehicle speed sensor is present.

methods.name: stopVSSPins
methods.description: Stops the vehicle speed sensor pins.

methods.name: startVSSPins
methods.description: Starts the vehicle speed sensor pins.
